# react-tiny-state

> A super simple React state management library (npm: `@jswork/react-tiny-state`) built on `React.createContext` + `useReducer` (~10 lines of core logic). It provides modular stores with `state` / `getters` / `actions` / `watch`, nested-path read/write (`nx.$get` / `nx.$set`), and global methods (`nx.$call`, `nx.$use`), with no dependencies beyond `@jswork/next`.

The library attaches a global API onto `nx` (from `@jswork/next`): `nx.$defineStore` declares a store module (state fields are proxied, getters are exposed as read-only properties), and `nx.$get` / `nx.$set` / `nx.$call` / `nx.$use` read, write, invoke actions, and consume state — both outside components and via the `nx.$use` hook inside them. The default export, `StateProvider`, merges every module's state into one root state (module keys are camelized) and provides it through a React context so updates re-render consumers and fire matching watchers.

## Documentation

- [README.md](README.md): Full getting-started guide covering store modules, composing stores, wrapping the app, and the complete API reference (`StateProvider`, `$defineStore`, `$registerStores`, `$get`, `$set`, `$call`, `$use`)

## Source

- [src/index.ts](src/index.ts): Core implementation — `$defineStore` (state proxying + getters), the `useReducer`-based `StateProvider`, and the `nx.$get` / `$set` / `$call` / `$use` global API
- [src/global.d.ts](src/global.d.ts): Type declarations for `StoreDescriptor`, `StateProviderProps`, and the `NxStatic` interface
- [src/utils.ts](src/utils.ts): Inlined utility functions (`camelize`, `slice2str`, `invoke`) that replaced the `@jswork/next-camelize` / `next-slice2str` / `next-invoke` packages

## Examples

- [Store module example (theme)](docs/src/shared/stores/modules/theme.ts): Shows `nx.$defineStore` with `state` and `watch` (including nested-path watchers like `child.n1`)
- [Store module example (user)](docs/src/shared/stores/modules/user.ts): Shows `nx.$defineStore` with `getters`, async `actions`, and `watch`
- [Stores composition](docs/src/shared/stores/index.ts): Globs and composes store modules via `import.meta.glob`
- [App wrapper usage](docs/src/App.tsx): Minimal React app wrapped with `StateProvider`
- [Component consumption](docs/src/comp1.tsx): Reads state inside a component with `nx.$get`
- [Tests](__tests__/index.spec.ts): Unit tests for the exported provider and the `camelize` / `slice2str` / `invoke` utils
